hypothesis: The native interleaved Q4_K GEMM forms [B0,B1,B4,B5] and [B2,B3,B6,B7] with a variable 8x32-bit permutation plus blend. Each pair is exactly a 128-bit-half concatenation and can be formed with one immediate vperm2i128, halving these data-motion instructions without changing any Q4/Q8 codes, integer dot products, floating accumulation order, or output storage.

implementation.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order v1 and promoted fused one-to-three-row v2
required_rewrite: replace blend(a, swap128(b), 0xF0) with permute2x128(a, b, 0x20)
replace blend(swap128(a), b, 0xF0) with permute2x128(a, b, 0x31)
apply only inside the AVX2 Q4_K GEMM path exercised by four-row verification

stop_rules: Reject if exhaustive byte-lane equivalence fails.
Reject before generation if graph speedup is below three percent or process medians are unstable.
Reject before CUTE if any committed token or draft count differs from control.
Do not reuse v5's row-major activation path.
claim_boundary: A pass promotes one algebra-preserving AVX2 data-motion optimization for the native interleaved Q4_K GEMM on four Milan cores. The trained approximation, final-node, energy, 100 accepted tok/s, and novelty gates remain open.
